name: app-lime-outline-phone-with-giant-looping-script-logo-on-dark-map
title: Lime Glow Phone under Looping Script Logo
whatItIs: A dark green poster with a giant lime looping script logo rising from behind a phone with a glowing lime rim, showing a travel home with tabs, destination cards and a trip planner card, over a faint map texture with labels in the corners.
whatItMeans: The huge glossy logo and lime glow make a strong brand poster, and corner captions frame it like a case-study cover.
techniques: Giant glossy logo behind the device
Lime rim light on the phone
Faint map texture as a background
Text captions in all four corners
Pill tabs with one lime selected

vocabulary.definition: A coloured light around the edge of a device.
A brand mark enlarged as the main graphic.
Faint map lines used as a background.
